purpose: 일의 강점이 능력 단정이 아니라 표정·손끝·첫 점검 도구에서 성취감과 부담으로 함께 읽히는 close-emotion 12개 편집 검토안이다.

renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-strength close-emotion guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair from the approved source; never add a coworker, manager, client, recipient, extra guardian, human, body clue, reflection, silhouette, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, relative size/colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes with exactly one large plus one small highlight in each visible eye, and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or canonical pair plus the focal diagnostic or guidance device covers 55–65% and remains readable at actual width 80px. Frame face, hands/fins and one bounded work control closely so capability, care, concentration and burden coexist; never show guaranteed mastery, flawless quality, leadership rank, applause, promotion or predetermined outcome. Written work surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, handwriting lines, names, labels, score, number, date, clock, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every connector, bridge, marker, button, clip, wedge, block, token, lamp, thread or coupler remains removable, half-set, open-ended, unlatched or still under inspection. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart tip is allowed; no added heart or heart-shaped light/void. No closed ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, deterministic route or completed mastery emblem. Keep every composition distinct in close camera height, hand action, focal-device silhouette and open negative-space shape. Follow compositionFamily, artDirection, distinctFrom and visualReviewFocus literally. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
